LG StanbyME 2 screens displayed in a modern living room. There is a StanbyME 2 on a stand, one is hung on the wall, and the other is propped up on a table using the folio cover.

sections.headline: Super Portable Screen
Roll it, hang it, detach it
sections.body:
Explore different ways to enjoy content and express your style. Roll the screen around with the adjustable stand. Detach it and hang it up. Or use it like a tablet with the folio cover.
Play videoPause video
disclaimers: *The screen automatically charges when you connect the power cable to the docking stand and attach the screen to its stand.
*Mobility may vary depending on flooring.
*Do not roll or drag the product outdoors as it may cause damage to the bottom.
*Screen angle adjustment range: Rotation (±90), Tilt (±25), Swivel (±90).

*Only use the provided wall mount holder from LG. During installation, the wall material should be taken into account. Otherwise, issues such as tilting or falling may occur. Refer to the manual provided for more information.
*Be cautious when mounting on the wall. Do not use for purposes other than intended.

assets.alt: A woman sitting in her outside balcony, watching content on an LG StanbyME 2 on the rollable, adjustable stand.

Different living spaces showing the different ways to use and enjoy the LG StanbyME 2 screen. Some spaces show it propped up like a tablet using the folio cover. Other spaces show it hung on the wall as a stylish addition to the interior design. Other spaces are showing how the screen can be easily mounted on the rollable, adjustable TV stand.

sections.headline: Enjoy a long-lasting built-in battery
sections.body:
Detach your LG StanbyME 2’s portable touch screen and watch content for longer. Take the screen everywhere. Improved battery power allows a single charge to deliver up to 4 hours of wireless playback.
Play videoPause video
disclaimers: *Up to 4 hours wireless use in Eco/Low Power Mode with built-in battery. Battery life may vary by usage. Requires a minimum output of 65W or more for charging. Devices must support USB PD.

*Screen may scratch if carried without a folio cover. Product may be damaged by impact from drops. This device is not water-or dust-resistant. Prolonged exposure to sunlight may cause discoloration or screen issues.

assets.alt: Close-up of StanbyME 2 screen being detached, transitioning to a model carrying it with the folio cover and strap.

sections.headline: Now with a USB-C port for better connectivity
sections.body: Made more convenient. Easily charge and connect your screen with the new USB-C port.
disclaimers: *Supports USB 2.0, USB-C DP, and DP ALT.
*For other devices to be connected, its USB-C port must support DP ALT.
*MacOS and iOS only support mirroring and charging.
*USB-C earphones and headphones are not supported.

assets.alt: Close-up shot of USB-C Cable attached to StanbyME 2.

sections.headline: Innovative, award-winning design
sections.body: Discover the award-winning StanbyME 2, our art frame screen celebrated for its design and functionality.

assets.alt: iF Design Award 2025 logo. Design Award Winner.

sections.headline: Big Tablet Screen
With Let's Draw, turn your ideas into art
sections.body: Create art using the full touch screen and display your masterpieces through the Always On Display.
disclaimers: *Touch pen is not included. No dedicated touch pen for StanbyME 2.
*Please ensure compatibility with third-party touch pens before purchase.

assets.alt: Model drawing on the screen of StanbyME 2.

sections.headline: Full Touch Screen
sections.body: The built-in 27-inch touch screen makes it easy and convenient to use, providing more ways to enjoy your screen. Draw, explore educational content, game and bring all your ideas to life with a touch.
disclaimers: *App availability may vary by region. Some apps may require a separate subscription.

assets.alt: StanbyME 2 with touchscreen in use by a person.

sections.headline: Enjoy board games together
sections.body: Enjoy titles like Memory Game, Million Marble, Spot the Difference, Chess, and more even without a smartphone. Play directly on the touch screen and enjoy casual fun with family and friends.
disclaimers: *App availability may vary by region. Subscription may be required for certain apps.

assets.alt: Three images showing StanbyME 2 used for different board games in a modern living space by three different parties.

sections.headline: Easily connect to other devices with HDMI and USB
sections.body: Connect your portable touch screen to a wide range of other devices. From monitors, laptops, IPTV set-top boxes, mobile devices, game consoles, and more through the built-in USB and HDMI ports.
disclaimers: *HDMI cables and other accessories should be purchased separately.

assets.alt: StanbyME 2 connected to another device displaying meeting materials.

sections.headline: Smart Cam for workouts, video calls, and more
sections.body: Connect a Smart Cam to the portable touch screen and enjoy additional video features. Use the camera for video calls. Use it when exercising to compare your movements with the workout video.
disclaimers: *Smart Cam is sold separately.

assets.alt: A woman in a yoga pose reflected on the screen of StanbyME 2.

sections.headline: Mirroring and OTT for a seamless entertainment experience
sections.body: Access your favorite content and streaming services even without a smartphone. Use the built-in OTT apps or mirror and stream from iOS and Android with AirPlay and Google Cast support.
disclaimers: *Requires the same network (Wi-Fi) connection.
*OTT services may require a separate subscription and purchase.
*LG StanbyME 2 is a display that operates on LG webOS. While it offers portability similar to tablet, it is product that uses a TV-based operating system.

assets.alt: StanbyME 2 in the center with multiple OTT programs arranged in a web formation around it.

sections.headline: Far-Field Voice Recognition
sections.body: StanbyME 2 can recognize your voice even from a distance. Just say "Hi LG" and it will begin listening to your requests from afar.
disclaimers: *This feature is available after enabling the product’s direct voice recognition function and agreeing to provide personal information.
*Voice recognition performance may vary depending on the surrounding environment. The effective recognition range can differ based on factors such as distance, background noise, and usage conditions.

assets.alt: A person using voice recognition on StanbyME 2, a speech bubble is visible with text that reads Hi, LG!

sections.headline: Magnetic clip-on remote
sections.body: Control your portable touch screen with a convenient remote. Its magnets snap to the side of your screen and folio cover, making it easy-to-reach and store.

sections.headline: New upgrades up to 5 years with award-winning webOS Re:New Program
sections.body: Keep your device's operating system up-to-date. Get full upgrades and enjoy the benefits of the latest features and software for your StanbyME 2.
disclaimers: *webOS Re:New Program applies to 2025 LG StanbyME 2.
*The webOS Re:New Program supports up to five years, the threshold is the pre-installed version of webOS, and upgrade schedule varies by model and region.
*Updates and the schedule to some features, applications, and services may vary by model and region.

assets.alt: Two images of StanbyME 2. One is of the magnetic remote attached to the topside of the device. Another is the magnetic remote attached to the back of the device.
webOS Re:New Program logo alongside CES Innovation Awards emblem.

sections.headline: Now with alpha 8 AI Processor and QHD for your screen
sections.body: Go beyond full HD and get QHD quality even on a 27-inch portable touch screen with the alpha 8 AI processor. Enjoy remarkable picture and sound on a convenient and portable screen.
disclaimers: *Compared to the same year entry level Smart TV alpha 7 AI Processor Gen8 based on internal spec comparison.

assets.alt: alpha 8 AI Processor chip visible with LG logo on an orange-lit mechanical plate.

sections.headline: AI Brightness Control adjusts screen brightness to any light
sections.body: Get the most optimal brightness settings. AI reacts to the ambient light in your space and automatically configures and adjusts your screen.
disclaimers: *All LG webOS 25 TVs feature AI Brightness Control, excluding those without light sensors.

assets.alt: StanbyME 2 mounted on a wall in a modern living space split between daytime and nighttime settings.
